summary: Owner: programmed with the NewChirp desktop app; channels are mainly VHF marine (156-162 MHz); radio beeps on PTT on every programmed channel; pre-write backup was deleted, so no before/after comparison is possible. Leading hypothesis: the radio's TX lockout outside the amateur bands, not a corrupted write. Not yet tested: whether a 2 m/70 cm amateur frequency in VFO mode transmits.
